visualInspection: All seven published screenshots visually inspected. Disclosure chevron visible, original text alignment retained, metadata hidden completely when folded, no clipping. Matching shared Markdown in both apps; sidebars differ.
startupObservations: Existing initial TockCoder workspaces.startSession is not a function and development CSP warning. TockTutor checks have no page or console errors.
